title: No Rest For Me And The Rest
description: A modpack that makes sure you will get no rest. Hords of different zombie variants and other monsters with improved AI will chase after you at high speeds moving through obstacles and breaking through walls. Concure them with advanced machinery.
body:
![Zombies chasing player](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d315fae70daf0bed9105c2c61d01ebfe11ce7569.jpeg)A modpack that makes sure you will get no rest. You cant sleep nor put a respawn point with your bed, you will have to craft an overworld anchor to finally settle down at the desired place. Hords of different zombie variants and other monsters with improved AI will chase after you at high speeds moving through obstacles and breaking through walls. Concure them with advanced machinery, magic, weaponry and companions. Good luck!


Contains temprature and dehydration mechanics*
